claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the thick, sturdy amber glass and overall build quality of the bottles.
Many reviewers appreciate the included accessories such as droppers, funnels, caps, labels, and markers.
Several reviewers find the bottles versatile and useful around the house for cleaning, toners, oils, and other liquids.
A few reviewers report problems with the sprayers, including one that didn't work and difficulty spraying oil.
Some reviewers note minor issues with the stickers not working well and the marker wiping off easily.
